description: This file defines a utility class ApiRequestContextHolder for managing thread-local instances of ApiRequestContext, providing methods to get, create, and clear the context within a request scope.

classes.name: ApiRequestContextHolder
classes.description: Final utility class providing thread-local management of ApiRequestContext instances.

methods.name: clearContext
methods.description: Removes the current ApiRequestContext from the thread-local storage.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the ApiRequestContext for the current thread; creates a new one if none exists.
